notice: problem、mechanism、applicability 和接口名称保留冻结公开事实。groups 是召回候选材料的中英文检索表达（含相邻方法），不声明 MOD 已实现其中每一种方法，也不补写原有故障。环节仅作辅助；自动命中只表示待核查线索，零命中不表示社区无人研究。

models: Qwen3.5-35B-A3B — DP2 functional; throughput benefit unconfirmed
applicability.requirements_zh: Manifest 0.3 wheel 已可发现并通过 clean-wheel 测试。ECPA 可表达启用意图，但启动仍要求精确匹配 runtime-qualification profile；打包不会扩大既有性能结论，也不会把 ADM 变成恢复协议。
applicability.requirements_en: The Manifest 0.3 wheel is discoverable and clean-wheel tested. ECPA may express enable intent, but launch still requires the exact runtime-qualification profile; packaging does not widen the published performance result or make ADM a recovery protocol.

applicability.requirements_zh: 使用文档指定的 wheel 校验和及精确 native 源码/import 检查。显式 enable 与 serve 分离，effective 要求三个模块均产生成功输出回执；disable 后须排空、停止旧服务并启动新原生进程。BF16 greedy 输出存在变化（Issue #23），HTTP/非空检查不是语义 oracle。最终 Manager 包与实机包通过全部运行时文件字节建立关联，分发元数据不同；不声明通用兼容、全套 CI 全过或性能收益。
applicability.requirements_en: Use the documented wheel hashes and exact native source/import checks. Explicit enablement and serve are separate; effective requires all three modules to report successful outputs. Disable applies to a drained, stopped service and a fresh native launch. BF16 greedy outputs vary (Issue #23); HTTP/nonempty checks are not a semantic oracle. The final Manager archive differs from the hardware archive only in verified distribution metadata, not runtime files. No universal compatibility, all-CI-pass or performance claim.

profiles.problem: 宿主使用外部 PegaFlow 服务保存和加载 KV 时，需要昇腾设备与宿主接口适配，并处理外部服务不可用的情况。
profiles.mechanism: 本组件把 vLLM-HUST 接入由外部运维者管理的 PegaFlow 服务，并提供 KV save/load 的昇腾/NPU 与 ECPA 适配。Manifest 0.3 将 Host Provider 打包进 runtime 持有的 Bundle，外部服务不可用时执行 fail-closed；它不负责启动、扩缩或修复 PegaFlow 服务，也不接管已存数据的生命周期。组件当前处于孵化阶段，仅在 Ascend 910B2、Qwen3.5-35B-A3B BF16 的固定配置上形成性能证据，尚不能外推到其他模型、设备或拓扑。

applicability.requirements_zh: PegaFlow 仍是由外部运维者管理的服务；实测 profile 要求 30 GiB pinned pool、PegaKVConnector read_write、APC、异步调度、Mamba align 与原生 MTP2。容量规划、故障恢复和数据留存仍由外部服务承担，结果不得外推到固定模型、设备与并行拓扑之外。
applicability.requirements_en: PegaFlow remains an external operator-owned service. The measured profile requires a 30 GiB pinned pool, PegaKVConnector read_write mode, APC, async scheduling, Mamba align, and native MTP2. Capacity planning, fault recovery, and stored-data retention remain external responsibilities; results must not be generalized beyond the pinned model, device, and parallel topology.

profiles.displayName: Prefix Router 前缀感知路由
profiles.problem: 前缀缓存分布在不同后端，单纯随机路由不能保证请求命中已有缓存。
profiles.mechanism: 可独立安装的外部前缀与生命周期感知 Router，提供有界 backend 连接池、请求负载核算、权威 KV 事件恢复、OpenAI 兼容转发以及健康、就绪和指标接口。 R10 3072 修订版 · CPU 回环验证通过合成 KV 事件驱动选路。默认和可信模式拒绝旧事件协议；冻结驻留缓存缺少对应的实际事件，未进行双副本性能测试。

applicability.host: External router over vLLM-HUST request fingerprint and KV events
applicability.requirements_zh: Router 需作为独立服务运维，并与 worker 对齐 tokenizer、block size、hash algorithm、宿主版本及 PYTHONHASHSEED。已发布测量对比 Prefix ON 与随机路由，而非无代理 Native 服务。
applicability.requirements_en: Operate the router as a separate service and keep tokenizer, block size, hash algorithm, host version and PYTHONHASHSEED aligned with workers. The published measurements compare Prefix ON with random routing, not with a no-proxy native server.

applicability.requirements_en: Requires the pinned CANN 9.1 / vLLM 0.23.0 source stack, KVCompress graph-slot backport 19f3221, TP2, APC, MTP2, async, chunked-prefill, FULL_AND_PIECEWISE and Mamba-align. Public package availability and five-dataset qualification remain open; the measured profile is not the official performance baseline.

applicability.requirements_en: Activation requires --kv-cache-dtype int8. TP2, Qwen3.5 hybrid cache, APC, MTP2, asynchronous scheduling, and the current Qwen3.5 graph-mode setting remain unqualified.
